title: Keyboard Sync
syncDescription: Light the keyboard in time with what's playing
mode.pulse.tip: Whole keyboard punches on every beat and shifts hue
mode.spectrum.tip: Bass, mids and treble across the four zones
mode.wave.tip: Each beat sweeps left to right
mode.theme.tip: Your theme color, flashing on the beat
noDevice: Keyboard RGB device not found. This needs the facer driver (/dev/acer-gkbbl-0).
typingDescription: Keys light up and ripple outward as you type
typingNoAccess: Can't read the built-in keyboard: your user needs the input group
notifyDescription: Flash when a notification arrives; red for critical, never in Do Not Disturb
keySoundsDescription: A switch click on every key press. Works on any keyboard
